types.name: Find the misspelt word
types.description: The options are four different words and the question asks which one is incorrectly, wrongly or misspelt (e.g. 'Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. Descendant / Deceased / Decimate / Desedent').

types.name: Choose the correct spelling
types.description: The options are four spellings of the same word and the question asks for the correctly spelt one (e.g. 'Select the correctly spelt word. propotion / proportion / preportion / proporsion').

types.name: Misspelt word in a sentence
types.description: A sentence is given (sometimes with words underlined or labelled A to D) and the question asks you to identify the incorrectly spelt word in it; the options are words or labels from the sentence.

types.name: Correct the misspelt word
types.description: A sentence contains a misspelt word (often underlined) and the options are corrected spellings of that word, sometimes with 'No error' or 'No improvement' as one option.

types.name: Correctly spelt word for a blank
types.description: A sentence has a blank and the options are spellings of one word (or similar-sounding words); choose the correctly spelt word that fills the blank.

types.name: Correct spelling of a word with a given meaning
types.description: The question gives a meaning (e.g. 'a word meaning to make less severe') and asks for the correct spelling; the options are four spellings of the same word.

types.name: Sentence with no spelling error
types.description: The four options are full sentences and the question asks which sentence has no spelling error, or which one has a spelling error.
